condition.access: READOBJECTS only; no input, window activation, app launch, capture, network, model call, or token output
condition.operation: one local Windows OS identity query

decision_rule: If any namespace component or active desktop witness is unavailable, do not derive a lock key and classify the result unknown. A single successful observation is only feasibility evidence, not cross-process uniqueness proof or admission-fence acceptance.
primary_discriminator: Return a stable, nonempty SHA-256 over current session ID, logon AuthenticationId and window-station name; separately report whether current thread desktop matches the active input desktop and UOI_IO confirms it is active.
purpose: Read whether the current Windows process can identify its logon session, window station, current thread desktop, and active input desktop using read-only APIs, as a candidate host-side lock namespace.
scope: Current Windows login only; no other session comparison, no producer, no input release, no late-input horizon, no task effect.
stop_rule: One read-only host probe. No retries.
